scope: Read-only exact-byte lookup for the 49 entries in baseline-dependencies.json. No source files imported, no app/tests/research executed, no commits or pushes.

method.comparison: For each exact path in each checked ref tip, read Git blob bytes and SHA-256 them; compare to baseline recorded SHA-256. Git blob object IDs were not treated as SHA-256. Also hash local worktree path if present.
method.history_or_object_scan: none; checked only exact paths at identified branch tips; no git log/object database scan beyond retrieving path blobs

checked_refs.owner_or_task_evidence: air-factor-parallel (coordination owner not established in inspected records)
legacy factor-unit-research (owner not established in current coordination snapshot)
legacy classic-factor-progress (owner not established in current coordination snapshot)

limitations: The checked refs are existing local remote-tracking or task refs identified from coordination records and branch inventory; no broad branch/history scan was performed.
A missing exact match means not present at the checked branch tip, not proof the bytes do not exist on another unexamined remote ref or in an ancestor commit.
Where multiple branches contain identical bytes, this establishes availability at those branch tips but not original authorship.
Coordination records identify some branch/task ownership; they do not assign every dependency path to a unique author.
Remote-tracking refs reflect their locally recorded tip; no fetch was performed in this audit.
